question: is there an lgbtq club at ramapo? and how do i join it
answer:
Yes. The directory lists Ramapo Pride (Student Organization), https://archway.ramapo.edu/Pride/ [1], and Allies of the Ramapough Munsee (Student Organization), https://archway.ramapo.edu/ARMS/ [2]. It also lists Women’s Center & LGBTQ+ Services (Department), https://archway.ramapo.edu/Womens/ [3].

To join Ramapo Pride, students who support the community are welcome [5]. All clubs listed on the clubs page are open to all students [7]. Email pride@ramapo.edu [4], or contact the Center for Student Involvement at csi@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7593, SC-202 [4]. The Women’s Center & LGBTQ+ Services says you can get involved by volunteering, attending its events, or joining a campus Pride organization [11]; contact it at women@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7468, C-220.

question: what faith or religious groups are there? im catholic but kinda open to anything
answer:
**Faith and Spirituality Services** offers regular and special on-campus worship services, counseling, and referrals to off-campus religious and social service organizations of all faiths. Website: https://www.ramapo.edu/ministries/ [1][2]

**The Multicultural Center and the Office of Access, Belonging and Community (ABC)** lists Muslim Student Association (MSA), InterVarsity Christian Fellowship (IVCF), Newman Catholic, Hillel, Chabad, and the Interfaith Prayer & Reflection Space H-201. [14]

**Center for Student Involvement** features Newman Catholic, Hillel, Chabad, and the Syriac Orthodox Club. Website: https://www.ramapo.edu/csi/ [8][9][11][12][13] Hillel offers religious and cultural programs and is open to students of all faiths; Email: hillel@ramapo.edu. [11] Chabad offers Jewish experiences and learning opportunities; Email: chabad@ramapo.edu. [12] The Syriac Orthodox Club welcomes everyone to participate and learn; Email:soc@ramapo.edu. [13]

**Faith and Spirituality Services — Newman Catholic:** It is open to all Ramapo faculty, staff, and students regardless of their religious beliefs. Activities include Sunday Mass, Bible Studies, OCIA classes, weekly Newman Nights, spiritual direction, and Confession. For more information contact David Donohoe, Campus Minister, (201) 800-4141, ddonohoe@ramapo.edu; or campusministry@ramapo.edu. Website: https://www.ramaponewman.com/ [4]

**Faith and Spirituality Services — IVCF:** You can join a small group at any time. Email ivcf@ramapo.edu to learn more. [6]

To form a religiously oriented student organization, contact the Center for Student Involvement in the Student Center. Registered students seeking a representative from a specific religious denomination may contact the Center for Student Involvement to arrange office time and allocation of space for services according to established college guidelines. [3]

question: is there a muslim student assocation or jewish group, hillel maybe?
answer:
Yes. Ramapo lists a Muslim Student Association (MSA). It aims to build understanding of Islam and community on campus. Email: msa@ramapo.edu. [3]

For Jewish students, Hillel offers religious and cultural programs and is open to students of all faiths. It holds weekly meetings with kosher food, and offers dinners, concerts, volunteer opportunities, and Shabbat and other holiday celebrations. Email: hillel@ramapo.edu. [2,4] Hillel programs are open to all members of the college community. [5,6]

The college also lists Chabad as a Jewish home offering experiences and learning opportunities. Email: chabad@ramapo.edu. [1]

You can find the groups through the linked pages: [MSA](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/muslim-student-association-msa/), [Hillel](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/hillel/), and [Chabad](https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/chabad/). [1–3]
